name: brand-voice
tagline_zh: 喂它三篇你欣赏的旧文，它就能提炼出专属文风档案，之后写推文、邮件、文案都自带那股味儿，不再有AI腔。
tagline_en: Feed it 3 samples, get a reusable voice profile. Then write posts, emails, and copy that sound like you—not AI.
desc_en: Build a source-derived writing style profile from real posts, essays, launch notes, docs, or site copy, then reuse that profile across content, outreach, and social workflows. Use when the user wants voice consistency without generic AI writing tropes.
why_zh: 不是套模板，而是从真实文本提取句式、用词和节奏，生成可复用的风格档案，比单一模仿更稳。
why_en: Extracts syntax, word choice, and rhythm from real samples into a reusable profile—more consistent than one-off mimicry.
